in_marathi.name: Janya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे She who is born
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'jan' meaning 'born'. In Hindu mythology, Janya refers to a divine being born from a deity.
